H01.description: byte_length + byte_offset can overflow usize (panic in debug, wraparound in release), bypassing the bounds check so an out-of-range DataView is created over the ArrayBuffer.
H01.reason: agreed defect, group, anchors, severity and description (byte_length + byte_offset can overflow usize, so the bounds check passes and an out-of-bounds DataView is created over the ArrayBuffer); category: the codebook's one word names the kind of defect — a bypassable bounds check in native-API code whose consequence is an out-of-bounds view (memory unsafety) is a security defect (A); input-validation (B) describes the mechanism, not the harm
